entries.doc: Helper module for the *bbox_inches* parameter in `.Figure.savefig`.
entries.doc_summary: Helper module for the *bbox_inches* parameter in `.Figure.savefig`.

entries.doc:
Temporarily adjust the figure so that only the specified area
(bbox_inches) is saved.

It modifies fig.bbox, fig.bbox_inches,
fig.transFigure._boxout, and fig.patch.  While the figure size
changes, the scale of the original figure is conserved.  A
function which restores the original values are returned.
entries.doc_summary: Temporarily adjust the figure so that only the specified area (bbox_inches) is saved.

entries.doc:
A function that needs to be called when figure dpi changes during the
drawing (e.g., rasterizing).  It recovers the bbox and re-adjust it with
the new dpi.
